adds.name: Tome of Legends
adds.reason: Repeatable draw — page counter whenever a commander enters or attacks. Fills the #1 gap (0 repeatable draw).

adds.name: Goldvein Pick
adds.reason: +1/+1 and a Treasure on combat damage — repeatable ramp/advantage off your evasive carrier.

adds.name: With Great Power . . .
adds.reason: +2/+2 for EACH aura/equipment attached — the literal Ardenn mass-attach payoff; scales the one-shot kill. Also completes a soft-lock with Anti-Venom.

adds.name: Twinblade Blessing
adds.reason: Flash double strike — doubles commander damage on the loaded carrier; Ardenn can relocate it.

adds.name: Hero's Blade
adds.reason: +3/+2 and auto-attaches free whenever a legendary enters — your commanders trigger it.

adds.name: Gift of Immortality
adds.reason: True recursion — the carrier dies and returns. Fills the no-recursion Losing hole.

adds.name: Holy Mantle
adds.reason: +2/+2 and protection from creatures — unblockable-by-creatures plus dodges creature removal. Evasion + protection in one.

adds.name: Samwise the Stouthearted
adds.reason: Flash-return a permanent that died this turn (including Equipment) — an instant-speed save for a killed carrier or blown-up artifact.

adds.name: Together Forever
adds.reason: Repeatable recursion engine — return a creature each turn. Grind insurance.

adds.name: Super Speed
adds.reason: {R} flash Aura granting first strike — cheap combat trick / toolbox piece, and an Aura for With Great Power. Replaced Squire's Lightblade (physical copy not found).

adds.name: Vibranium Energy Daggers
adds.reason: Indestructible +2/+2 stat-stick — survives board wipes and turns Dead-Iron Sledge one-sided; Ardenn can shuffle it between carriers.

adds.name: Spirited Companion
adds.reason: Enchantment-creature body with ETB draw — replaces itself and is an extra attach target.

adds.name: Errand-Rider of Gondor
adds.reason: {2}{W} ETB draw a card — with your commanders on the board there's no downside; a body that refills the hand. Replaced Inspiring Overseer (physical copy not found).

adds.name: Hero in Training
adds.reason: {2}{W} ETB draw a card (+2 life with another Hero) — immediate card advantage. Replaced Novice Inspector (physical copy not found).

adds.name: Swiftfoot Boots
adds.reason: Hexproof + haste — cheap, reusable carrier protection, replacing a vanilla +1/+1 stick.

adds.name: The Black Arrow
adds.reason: Flash equip +1/+1 with an ETB ping — a cheaper, flexible interactive equip / attach target vs mv5 removal.

adds.name: Sol Ring
adds.reason: The format's best accelerant ({1} → {C}{C}) — deploys the equipment toolbox a full turn early, the Development axis a low-curve voltron deck most wants. Owned (avail 5); replaced Evolving Wilds after the physical copy couldn't be found.

adds.name: Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer
adds.reason: Recursion body (ETB: return a creature card from your graveyard) — fills the Losing/recursion gap. Also completes a soft-lock with With Great Power (all damage to you redirects to Anti-Venom, who prevents it and grows). On-color, owned; replaces the mv7 curve outlier.

drops.name: Silent Arbiter
drops.reason: Anti-synergy stax — caps you to one attacker, kills Moraug's extra combats. A stated does-not-want.

drops.name: Exploding Barrel
drops.reason: Durdly {8} one-shot removal on a slow rock.

drops.name: Fanatical Devotion
drops.reason: Regeneration needs a sac-fodder board this deck doesn't build; Anti-Venom / Gift of Immortality do the recursion job better.

drops.name: Indomitable Will
drops.reason: Vanilla +1/+2 aura — no evasion or protection.

drops.name: Chimeric Coils
drops.reason: Marginal {1} mana-sink ({X}{1}: become an X/X, then sac) — off the voltron axis. (This is the card the Airtable record was drifted on; now reconciled and cut.)

drops.name: Kyoshi Battle Fan
drops.reason: Makes a 1/1 token — off the single-carrier plan.

drops.name: Terashi's Verdict
drops.reason: Narrow — attacker with power 3 or less.

drops.name: Shadowfax, Lord of Horses
drops.reason: Benched — NOT an extra-combat engine (I mislabeled it). It only cheats one power-≤3 creature into the attack, AFTER Ardenn's begin-combat attach window, so it comes in naked; 'Horses have haste' is dead (no other Horses); mv5 off-axis. Cut for Sol Ring.

drops.name: Meteor Sword
drops.reason: mv7 Equipment — the single worst curve outlier in a low-curve deck; almost never hard-cast.

drops.name: Soul Nova
drops.reason: mv5 removal — redundant in a 17-piece removal suite; trimming the most expensive one costs nothing.

drops.name: Leonin Scimitar
drops.reason: mv1 +1/+1 vanilla equip — pure filler now that Hero's Blade, Goldvein Pick, and Vibranium Energy Daggers are joining.

drops.name: Gold Myr
drops.reason: 2-mana W mana dork — the mana base is healthy at 36 lands, so dead ramp that dies to any wipe. Cut to fund keeping Chimil/Slagwurm/Dead-Iron/Myr Retriever.

drops.name: Iron Myr
drops.reason: 2-mana R mana dork — same: redundant ramp with a healthy land base.

drops.name: Serum Tank
drops.reason: mv3 charge-counter draw engine — far too slow ({3}{T}, remove a counter for one card). Durdle off-plan.

drops.name: Coldsteel Heart
drops.reason: mv2 enters-tapped rock — redundant fixing the deck doesn't need with 36 lands.

considerations.name: Web-Shooters
considerations.reason: Taps a blocker on attack (pseudo-evasion) + reach — marginal against tighter equipment slots.

considerations.name: Whispersilk Cloak
considerations.reason: Unblockable + shroud — strong carrier tech; held only because protection/evasion is already covered (Holy Mantle, Vibranium, Swiftfoot).

considerations.name: Talisman of Conviction
considerations.reason: RW mana rock — deprioritized once we confirmed the mana base is healthy at 36 lands.

considerations.name: Fellwar Stone
considerations.reason: Cheap any-color rock — same ramp-not-needed reason.

considerations.name: Ragged Short Spear
considerations.reason: Discard-to-draw-two + 2/0 — card filtering stapled to an equip.

considerations.name: Crown of Fury
considerations.reason: First strike + sacrifice-for-a-swing — niche combat trick.

considerations.name: Forgotten Cave
considerations.reason: Cycling land / flood insurance — deprioritized (land base healthy).
